node.statement: Apply lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities at n=1 to the ambient element ab and use the involution law: (a dot b)^dagger=Co_{A,C}(ab)^dagger=Co_{C,A}((ab)^dagger)=Co_{C,A}(b^dagger a^dagger)=b^dagger dot a^dagger. No associativity estimate or unregistered premise is used.
